blind.description: A stylized stone wayside shrine featuring a stepped rectangular base, a gabled pitched roof, and an arched central niche containing a hooded, cloaked figure statue. A small ledge beneath the niche holds an offering bowl flanked by two dripping, unlit pillar candles. The back consists of plain masonry ashlar blocks. Geometry is solid, clean, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or holes.
blind.from_above: A rectangular profile dominated by a pitched stone roof ridge, with the protruding lower shelf visible showing the tops of two dripping candles and a central offering bowl.
blind.height_vs_figure: About the same height as the 5 ft 9 in figure (reaches to roughly neck/head level, around 5 ft 6 in tall), and roughly 2.5 ft wide.
